intro.title: Different Perspectives
intro.text: The systems around us shape how we live. What we own. What we keep. How we use energy. How we relate to one another. These are shared questions, open to different interpretations.

paragraphs: Most of the systems that shape our lives were designed by someone. They influence what we own, what we keep, how we use energy, and how we live together.
These are shared questions, but there are no single answers. We bring artists, designers and makers together to explore them through independent perspectives and creative work.
